verdict.rationale: Finix documents seller payouts to bank accounts or cards and balance top-ups via ACH or wire. Nothing in the pack covers local-currency payouts, FX conversion, or settlement over non-US local bank rails for international sellers. The 'International charges' fee customization is a pricing control, not an international payout capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, international sellers get paid properly — local-currency payouts, documented FX handling, and settlement to local bank rails rather than expensive wires
